steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?
Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In November 2023, Equity Mates noted most Australian baby retailers went broke and Baby Bunting was left standing, indicating a resilient position in its niche after a sector shake-out.

episode.title: We review the 16 stocks pitched at the Sohn Hearts & Minds conference

steps.q: Can it reinvest its profits productively?

views.text: In June 2020, a guest on Equity Mates used Baby Bunting as a case study of exiting after a decade because the company chose not to expand internationally, suggesting fewer high-return reinvestment opportunities as it matured and growth slowed below a 20 percent target.
